# EDV On The Fly

> > Your first-class seat to Endeavor Air news, employee recognition, and community impact stories.

EDV On The Fly is the official blog and news hub for Endeavor Air, a regional airline partner of Delta Air Lines. The site celebrates employee achievements, highlights corporate social responsibility initiatives, and shares stories about company culture and community partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Endeavor Air
- Employee Recognition
- Corporate Social Responsibility
- Community Service
- Employee Awards
- Charity Initiatives
- Company Culture
- Regional Airline
- Delta Air Lines
- Community Partnerships
- Employee Spotlight
- Veteran Support
- Corporate Partnership
- Employee Engagement
- Aviation Industry

## Employee Recognition & Awards

- [Celebrating our 2025 Endeavor's Elite Honorees](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/10/14/celebrating-our-2025-endeavors-elite-honorees): 2025 Endeavor's Elite Annual Employee Awards honoring 39 outstanding employees
- [Endeavor's First Class Flight Attendants](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/09/25/endeavors-first-class-flight-attendants): Recognition of top 1% flight attendants in customer service excellence program
- [A Summer Immersion: Celebrating Endeavor's 2025 Summer Interns](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/07/31/a-summer-immersion-celebrating-endeavors-2025-summer-interns): Spotlight on 13 summer interns gaining aviation industry experience at Endeavor

## Community Impact & Charity

- [Bringing Magic to Flight: Endeavor Air Supports Bert's Big Adventure](https://edvonthefly.com/2026/02/26/bringing-magic-to-flight-endeavor-air-supports-berts-big-adventure): Endeavor Air partnership with Bert's Big Adventure supporting children's Disney trips
- [A Pink Flight of Hope and Healing](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/10/31/a-pink-flight-of-hope-and-healing-everything-pink): Annual Breast Cancer Research Foundation flight featuring Endeavor and Delta employees
- [Supporting Veterans in the Community](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/11/10/supporting-veterans-in-the-community): Veterans Day recognition of Endeavor Air's 500+ veteran employees and community support
- [Lifting up the Community](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/05/27/lifting-up-the-community): Employee volunteer spotlight supporting Special Olympics powerlifting competition

## Employee Stories & Culture

- [Creating a Paws-itive Impact](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/08/29/creating-a-paws-itive-impact): Employee spotlight on service dog training volunteer with Can Do Canines
- [Flying Solo](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/05/30/flying-solo): Flight attendant Darniqua Bowen's children's book empowering young flyers
- [Perks That Fly: Endeavor Employees take Spontaneous Day Trips with their Flight Benefits](https://edvonthefly.com/2025/08/22/perks-that-fly-endeavor-employees-take-spontaneous-day-trips-with-their-flight-benefits): Feature on Endeavor employee flight benefits and spontaneous travel opportunities
